categories.label: 健壮性与稳定性
categories.definition: A unit test is fragile or unstable under valid environment, timing, or input variation.
decision_rules: test depends on time, order, network, or random behavior
positive_hints: deterministic input or clock is used

categories.label: 资源与生命周期管理

decision_rules: resource is created but not closed
